summary: shell options: chdir, cmd, creates/removes guards, executable to change the shell, free-form command, stdin and stdin_add_newline.
questions: How do I run a shell command with bash instead of sh?
How do I pass input to stdin of a command?
How do I make a shell task run only once?
How do I run a command in a specific directory?

answer_card.title: shell parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- free-form or `cmd`
- `chdir`: working dir
- `creates` / `removes`: skip if file exists / is missing
- `executable`: absolute shell path, e.g. `/bin/bash`
- `stdin`, `stdin_add_newline` (true)
